name: layz
description: Download social videos, remove watermarks and burned-in text, enhance or upscale footage, run video workflows, and make entire videos with layZ AI — open the web video editor to tweak, or let the AI finish and export so you get the complete video in chat.

interface.longDescription:
layZ AI turns ChatGPT and Codex into a full video workflow for creators. Start a workflow, create a video, then either open the layZ web video editor to adjust the timeline yourself, or let the AI handle everything and export so the finished video lands right in chat.

Paste a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Reels, Shorts, or similar link and layZ downloads the clip, cleans it up, and gets it ready to publish. Make entire videos end to end, from script and voiceover through edit and export. Remove watermarks, captions, and burned-in text. Enhance and upscale footage. Analyze clips and build timeline edits with live progress in your layZ workspace.

Connect your layZ account once, then ask for what you need: download, clean, enhance, edit, run a workflow, or create a full video, and layZ handles the rest.
defaultPrompt: Download this YouTube video and remove the watermark with layZ AI.
Pull this TikTok, remove the text overlay, then enhance it with layZ AI.
Use layZ AI to download this Instagram Reel, clean it, and upscale it.
